note:
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER led TW at £8,406.79, up 70.1% WoW from £4,942.19 LW, holding 13.6% share at Rank 1.
- The four EDWARDIAN PARASOL and RUFFLED UMBRELLA colourways plus EDWARDIAN PARASOL NATURAL combined for £14,211.15 TW versus £14,461.70 LW, a WoW decline of 1.7%.

- Hot water bottles showed broad TW gains: RED SPOT HEART £1,808.44 (up 112.6% WoW), GREY HEART £1,394.46 (up 126.7% WoW), and CHICK GREY £1,076.30 (up 155.1% WoW).
- BLACK RECORD COVER FRAME (£1,144.96, up 185.5% WoW) and WILLOW BRANCH LIGHTS. (£1,033.11, up 185.0% WoW) posted the two largest WoW percentage increases in the table.
- WHITE CHERRY LIGHTS declined 54.1% WoW to £1,213.62 TW and PINK CHERRY LIGHTS declined 42.1% WoW to £1,130.42 TW.
- No LY revenue is recorded for any of the 30 rows, so YoY change is unavailable for TW 2009-W50.

calls.system:
You are a retail analyst who writes the weekly executive insight note for senior leaders. You report only what the sales table shows.

Format rules for the note:
- Write 6 to 8 bullet lines. Start each line with "- " and state exactly one insight per line.
- Every line names at least one entity from the data and contains at least one number.
- Label every period explicitly: TW (this week), LW (last week), LY (same ISO week last year), WoW (week over week change), YoY (year over year change).
- Revenue is in GBP. Write money with the £ sign.
- State facts only. Do not give recommendations, advice, or explanations of causes.
- Plain text only. No title, no headings, no markdown tables, no bold, no text before or after the bullets.
- Do not use em dashes.
